pages.title: Showcase: what the engine can and can not draw
FOAF to SVG through XSLT
pages.shows: RDF/XML FOAF read by XSLT 3.0; people on a circle with math:sin and math:cos; knows links as curves, mutual links found; a table; interests counted; Latin, Armenian (fallback font), Greek and Cyrillic names
pages.doesNotShow: Factoidal's RDF parser (the stylesheet reads one RDF/XML layout); SVG text (labels are glyph outlines set by XSLT, issue 1270)

pages.title: SPARQL results through XSLT
pages.shows: real SPARQL 1.1 results from Factoidal's engine over foaf-people.xml, as Query Results XML; XSLT makes a table from the variables and a two-sided bar chart
pages.doesNotShow: a query run by the browser: the query ran once, ahead of time, with the factoidal command

pages.title: A feed reader with no JavaScript
pages.shows: an Atom feed with an XSLT 3.0 stylesheet: entries sorted and grouped by day, dates in words, a strip chart of entries each day
pages.doesNotShow: a built-in feed view for a feed that names no stylesheet; RSS 2.0 and RSS 1.0 (issue 1287)

pages.title: Sitemap explorer
pages.shows: a sitemap of these demo pages: XSLT 3.0 date arithmetic, sorting by lastmod, grouping, a bar chart of pages changed each day, priority bars in table cells
pages.doesNotShow: a built-in sitemap view; re-sorting by a click

pages.title: Tables that compute
pages.shows: file counts, lines and bytes of labs/demos/foafnaut; XSLT computes totals, shares and means into a CSS table, and draws a ring chart with SVG arcs and a bar chart
pages.doesNotShow: numbers aligned right or bold totals (text-align and font-weight are dropped, issue 1273)

pages.title: The engine explains itself
pages.shows: an XML description of foafnaut's stages, drawn by XSLT 3.0 as an SVG diagram with gradients, dashes and glyph-outline labels, and as a table of Lean files and proof files

pages.title: Typography lab
pages.shows: the Lean shaper (kerning, ligatures, mark positioning, fallback font) beside the same strings set as unshaped glyph outlines by XSLT; a size ladder
pages.doesNotShow: bold or italic: one face, and font-weight and font-style are dropped (expected failure, issue 1273)

pages.title: Print-ready poster and cards
pages.shows: three sheets on screen; on paper, @media print rules hide the screen note and colours, break-before starts each sheet on a page, break-inside: avoid keeps each card whole (3 pages on A4)
pages.doesNotShow: page numbers, running headers and @page margins

pages.title: Timers and clicks
pages.needs: page scripts in foafnaut (QuickJS in the Lean Wasm VM) for part 1, and an event loop for part 2
pages.shows: today: the static page; with scripts: click listeners, textContent and setAttribute on SVG shapes; with an event loop: a setTimeout countdown
pages.doesNotShow: any script effect on this engine yet; the page says so in its text

pages.title: SVG text labels
pages.needs: SVG text and textPath with real fonts (the svg-text work)
pages.shows: when the engine draws SVG text: names in Noto Sans and Noto Sans Armenian beside their circles, and a caption along an arc
